subject: DPA envelope orchestration: signatory tiers, countersign timing, and health-check cadence
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.j@acme.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legal.ops@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: DPA envelope orchestration + signatory matrix

Hi Alex —

Thanks for moving this forward. We reviewed the DPA redlines and the signoff path on our side; attaching our proposed signatory matrix. A few quick questions before we start the envelope:

- Can Redwood accept a delegated signer for the CTO-level signoff (they want to have a named delegate listed in DocuSign)?
- Do you have a two-step countersign approach (customer signs first, Redwood countersigns), or do you prefer parallel signers?
- If there are role mismatches, will DocuSign pause the envelope and allow us to re-assign, or will it void and require a new envelope?

We want to avoid back-and-forth re-issuance if possible — any routing logic you can confirm will help.

Attachments: signatory_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Claire Jensen
Senior Counsel, Acme Corporation

On behalf of LegalOps team

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.j@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA envelope orchestration + signatory matrix

Hi Claire — thanks for the matrix and the callouts. High level: we can support your preferred flow with a couple of operational guardrails. Summary below; details and ask at the end.

1) Routing model we recommend (DocuSign):
   - Signing order (routingOrder): Acme signers (order 1) -> Optional reviewer (order 2, internal at Acme if requested) -> Redwood countersigners (order 3).
   - We set recipientRoles with allowDelegation enabled for specific positions (e.g., CTO delegate). Delegation inserts a new recipient but preserves routingOrder.

2) Pause vs. Void behavior:
   - DocuSign will typically "pause" when a recipient is re-assigned (delegation) if configured with in-flight recipient updates. We will NOT mark envelopes as void unless required by legal.
   - We will add an instruction and a conditional workflow: if a required recipient cannot be reached or delegation is denied, route to a named fallback (LegalOps group address) rather than voiding.

3) Countersign timing and SLA:
   - Standard: we aim to countersign within 72 hours after final Acme signature. For this engagement we can commit to 48 hours provided the envelope reaches our legal mailbox with an intact signing audit trail.

4) Monitoring and health checks:
   - We will attach a DocuSign Connect webhook to the envelope for real-time status callbacks to legal-inbox@redwood.com.
   - Redwood will also poll the envelope status via DocuSign API every 2 hours until complete; if no progress after 48 hours, we will escalate to Marissa (Contracts) and David (Ops).

Action items / asks for you:
- Confirm the delegate name(s) you want allowed for the CTO role (we can pre-authorize email addresses).
- Confirm whether Acme wants parallel signing for Finance / Procurement; otherwise we will set strict sequential order.
- Provide the final PO number (if applicable) to include in the envelope metadata.

If that works, we will prepare the envelope today and share the status link.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Head of GTM Ops (Contracting)
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME DPA — routing plan and fallback options

Team — forwarding Claire's matrix (attached) and my reply. Quick internal decisions needed before I issue the envelope:

- Delegation: Claire asked for an allowed delegate for Acme's CTO position. We should pre-authorize delegation only for vendor-trusted domains and require email verification. Marissa, please confirm if legal is comfortable listing a named delegate (we have to lock that email into the DocuSign recipient role).
- Countersign SLA: I'm proposing a 48-hour countersign SLA for priority accounts (Acme is priority). David, can your team ensure the webhook pipeline (DocuSign Connect) will route callbacks to legal-inbox@redwood.com and trigger the 2-hour poller? If Connect fails, we must fallback to polling only.
- Fallback to AdobeSign: If DocuSign API returns 5xx errors while creating the envelope, we will generate an AdobeSign envelope using the same recipient roles and annotate the event with the original DocuSign envelope ID for audit. Soojin, please prepare an AdobeSign template mapping as contingency.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa confirm delegate policy and accept pre-authorized email(s).
2) David confirm webhook/poller readiness and escalation steps.
3) I will draft the envelope with routingOrder and reminders (48-hour remindeR cadence to signers).

Thanks — please reply with short confirmations.

--
Alex
